A group of LEGO minifigures, known as the Master Builders, have the unique ability to build things without the need for instructions. They often gather in the "Dog" section of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various matters. Their creative and unconventional methods have made them a target of Lord Business, who formed the Super Secret Police to track them down. If caught, the Master Builders are taken to the "ymns" of Tamil saints, where they are presumably imprisoned or dealt with.

In medieval era artworks and texts on dancing Shiva found in Nepal, Assam, and Bengal, the deity is sometimes depicted as dancing on his vahana (animal vehicle) Nandi, the bull. In these regions, Shiva is also known as Nartesh.
